text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: api-gateway-error-rate spike (502/504) in eu-west-1 — alert threshold 5% -> current 26% (10m)

sara: seeing the same in dashboards, spike started ~3m ago, 502s coming from gateway edge pool, lat p50/p95 both up. forwarding logs.

james: oncall? @oncall are you free to take this?

oncall: I'm on it, joining. what is the customer impact?

maria: initial telemetry shows error rate concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. 40% of requests see upstream timeout 504, remainder 502 from proxy. A handful of high-rate customers contributing.

liam: any recent deploys in that window? I don't see infra deploys but there was a routing config push at 7851234500 (edge proxy weights).

sara: good call. correlating now. if it lines up with the weight change, could be fanout to a degraded backend.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 — paging escalation in #oncall and #incidents. Playbook: api-gateway-5xx.

oncall: starting live triage. priority = high. immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable circuit breaker for /v1/generate 2) throttle heavy customers 3) roll traffic back off new routing weights 4) add replicas if needed. who can run the weight rollback?

james: I can rollback the routing weights. patch ID was cfg-2026-178. rolling back now. command: `edgectl config rollback cfg-2026-178 --commit`

sara: throttling top callers temporarily: adding ip-based rate-limit rule for /v1/generate to 10r/s for those callers. putting the rule in dry-run -> active.

liam: enabling circuit breaker with lower concurrency threshold for generate endpoints: `kubectl patch deploy edge-proxy -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"cb:enabled":"true","cb:threshold":"50"}}}}}'`

maria: starting to route a small percent to eu-central (fallback region) for resiliency, 10% -> 30% ramp if stable.

ops-bot: deployment system: rollback complete (cfg-2026-178) — change applied by james at 7851234590.

sara: after rollback and throttle we see immediate decrease in 502s for non-chat endpoints. p95 down from 1.8s -> 900ms, overall 5xx from 26% -> 12% (next 60s).

oncall: good. still seeing concentrated 504s on a subset of upstream hosts: usg-serve-07 and usg-serve-08. tailing logs now. `ssh gateway@usg-serve-07 'sudo journalctl -u ingress -n 200'`

james: logs show a lot of upstream reset / connection refused around 7851234556-7851234580. backends reporting high GC pause and connection drops. could be a model worker spike.

liam: can we scale the model-serving pool? invoking autoscale request: `kubectl scale deployment model-worker --replicas=30 -n ml-prod`

maria: autoscale accepted, pods coming up. also toggled soft-cache fallback for common prompt prefixes to reduce backend load.

sara: rebalancing edge weights to avoid usg-serve-07/08 temporarily. reroute command: `edgectl route adjust --exclude usg-serve-07,usg-serve-08 --percent 100` (applying gradual reroute).

ops-bot: telemetry: after reroute and scale, 5xx -> 4.7% in next 90s, p95 stable. notifying support to surface affected customers.

oncall: good containment. next: root cause triage — are model workers overloaded or a memory leak? james can you capture heap/profile of one failing pod?

james: grabbing heap dump from model-worker-07-zz, saving to s3://redwood-dumps/7851234567/heap-07.hprof. also creating incident ticket for ML infra.

maria: I've messaged the top 5 customers in the affected window with a blameless note: short outage impacting generation endpoints, mitigation in progress, ETA for next update 15m.

liam: ops note: we also saw a spike in concurrent long-poll requests from a single integration—rate-limited that integration and notified their contact.

sara: metrics look stable for 5m now. 5xx at 1.2%, p95 back to expected. keeping the circuit breaker and throttles for 10m as a safety buffer.

oncall: switching to monitoring phase. handoff to oncall-rotation for postmortem and RCA. please file notes: actions taken (rollback cfg-2026-178, throttled heavy callers, enabled circuit breaker, scaled model-worker, rerouted away from failing hosts).

james: filing the timeline in INC-2026-045 and tagging ML infra + Edge teams. attaching logs and heap dump link.

maria: customer update: sent follow-up with root cause in-progress. will wait for ML team analysis before final customer-impact statement.

ops-bot: Incident update: mitigation successful, mitigation->monitoring transition at 7851234630. Incident severity downgraded to SEV3.

sara: quick lessons: add automated detection for routing weight pushes + runbook step to validate backend health before pushing. also consider conservative default circuit breaker values.

oncall: agreed. I'll open a follow-up Jira for runbook edits and a postmortem meeting invite. great work team. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Closing note: if errors resurface reopen INC-2026-045 or ping #oncall.
